exposure: Outpatient endometrial polyp removal using Myosure device
Parous women with only Cesarean deliveries
Parity (nulliparous, parous with only Cesarean deliveries, parous with vaginal deliveries)
cohort: 42 women undergoing outpatient removal of endometrial polyps
finding: Outpatient endometrial polyp removal using the Myosure device was associated with high patient satisfaction, low pain scores, and a high rate of complete resection.
